searchText: Perhaps I'm missing something but I thought the first attempt to Holesky could not have a single valid block, therefore no validator can be "online" some validators managed to produce blocks by re-generating the EL config and keeping the CL config the same we could have rescued the whole network if we'd been dedicated to this approach
